shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: A stylish, attractive Nigerian woman in her early thirties, natural hair neatly styled, wearing a fitted Ankara-print top, sits on a cream sofa in a bright, modern living room of a Lekki estate duplex, holding her smartphone in both hands and smiling slightly as she completes a payment. Through the window behind her: interlocking paving, a painted perimeter fence and palms. Soft late-morning daylight. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: why
shots.prompt: A well-groomed, handsome Nigerian man in his early forties in a crisp white kaftan stands at the gate of his duplex in a gated Abuja estate, glancing at his phone with a relaxed, satisfied expression. Behind him: interlocking paving, a black water tank on a stand, a neat hedge and a painted fence. Warm early-evening light. Phone screen facing away from camera.

shots.name: tip
shots.prompt: Two elegant Nigerian estate committee members, a woman in her fifties wearing a gele and a man in his sixties in a tailored senator suit, talk warmly on the shaded veranda of an estate clubhouse, one holding a printed folder. Palms and a generator housing in the soft background. Bright overcast daylight, neutral white balance.
